body.name: Conditional pilot-information-to-action handle
body.construction: \(\mathsf H_{\mathrm{eff}}\) is the following conditional proof route: start from the exact pilot likelihood and the realized information matrix \(I_m^{\mathrm{pil}}\); if that matrix has a nonsingular limit along a stated sequence, derive the corresponding nuisance-projected LAN experiment, construct its regular plug-in action on \(T_{n,m}^{\mathrm{main}}\), and separately compare its Gaussian quadratic loss with the exact finite Horvitz--Thompson action-loss contrast.  The handle does not assert information convergence, estimator efficiency, or the finite-boundary transfer.
